symptoms: NSTEMI / STEMI with cardiac failure or LV dysfunction

management_steps.details: NSTEMI / STEMI / CCF: target dose 10 mg 12 hourly (usually titrated from 2.5 mg 12 hourly up to maximum 10 mg twice daily). Hypertension (Step 3): 10 mg once daily. Hypertension (Step 4 / 6): 20 mg once daily.
Titrate dosages gradually upwards. Monitor renal function and potassium.

warnings: Angioedema is a potentially serious complication of ACE-inhibitor treatment and if it occurs it is a contraindication to continue therapy or to re-challenge.
